_use_when: The post wants a human, work in progress feel, not proof. A real photo from the person always beats generating this. If generated, it is a mood image and the post must not treat it as evidence.

output.mobile_read: The handwritten note and the cluttered work setup should be recognisable.

main_visual.description: A casual phone photo of an open notebook next to a laptop, with a rough handwritten list on the page.
main_visual.state_or_action: Notebook open on a desk, laptop corner in frame, a mug cut off by the edge.

composition.framing: top down phone shot with a slight handheld tilt
composition.layout: notebook lower center, laptop corner top left, mug half out of frame

camera_and_light.lighting: window light mixed with laptop screen glow
camera_and_light.texture: slight motion softness, paper grain, ordinary phone noise

text_elements.rules: The only readable writing in the image.
